english.title: Attach a pipe or apparatus to service pipe not belonging to licensee or undertaker but which served premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the water supply licensee, attached

(A)_[a pipe]_
(B)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..)]_

to a service pipe which did not belong to a water supply licensee or a water undertaker but was a pipe by means of which water was supplied by such a licensee to premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(3A)(b) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
